entities.summary: The Ala-Archa Cemetery is a public cemetery for honoured individuals in Kyrgyzstan. It is located on Abdumomunova Street in Bishkek to the west of the Avenue of the Young Guards. It is near the Ala Archa National Park in the Tian Shan mountains. It was opened in 1948 and currently occupies 31 hectares of land. It has historical and cultural significance in the City of Bishkek due to its regular use by order of the Government of Kyrgyzstan for the burial and/or re-burial of Kyrgyz citizens who held the status of political or public status such as former Prime Ministers as well as distinguished persons in the fine arts. Ala-Archinskoe Cemetery is a cemetery with roots in Asia.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a public cemetery for honoured individuals in Kyrgyzstan, Ala-Archa Cemetery has played a significant role in the country's cultural and political landscape. Since its opening in 1948, it has been used to bury and re-bury notable citizens, including former Prime Ministers, contributing to the city's historical heritage.
